context.person: A person using an online marketplace account
context.user_goal: Report an unrecognized attempt to sign out other sessions and start recovery.

product_state.preceding_state: A sign-in from a new browser was blocked until the account owner confirms whether it was theirs.
product_state.current_state: The sign-in was blocked. The attempt occurred at 8:14 PM from a new browser.
known_facts: The attempt occurred at 8:14 PM from a new browser.
Confirming the attempt allows that browser to try again.
Reporting it signs out other sessions and starts account recovery.
forbidden_claims: The blocked browser is already trusted.
Changing the password is the only recovery effect.

current_content.subject: An update for you
current_content.heading: Heads up!
current_content.body: Some details have changed. Review your account.

challenge: Rewrite the transactional email so the person can understand suspicious sign-in confirmation, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: Confirm that the sign-in was theirs.
interaction_contract.secondary_action: Report the attempt and start recovery.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The new browser cannot access the account until the attempt is confirmed.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Report an unrecognized attempt to sign out other sessions and start recovery.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
